text:
Situation: Bacteriostatic water is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2021-12-03, since resolved. Current stock: Corvale East has 40 units (11.3 days); Corvale General has 83 units (19.5 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06, classified OAI, letter dated 2020-05-25 (819 days before shortage posting). FDA inspection 1110899 at Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) ended 2019-11-21, classified VAI, letter dated 2020-02-12 (743 days before). FDA inspection 1115467 at Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) ended 2020-01-17, classified VAI, letter dated 2020-04-15 (686 days before). Warning Letter issued 2020-03-25 (case 594972) to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (618 days before). FDA OAI classification letter to Hospira, Inc. dated 2020-04-22 (590 days before) and to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited dated 2020-05-25 (557 days before).

Our position: Supply is limited but not in FDA shortage status. We have two viable procurement paths.

Recommended actions:
1. Purchase from Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd. — not on FDA shortage list today; label names no identifiable plant. Approval required: buyer.
2. Switch to Sterile Water 1 mL/mL from Nephron Pharmaceuticals Corporation per protocol approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-07-09. Approval required: treating prescriber.

Not recommended: No further action at this time.
